visual.general_description: Grayscale curvilinear ultrasound sector image with white arrows and text labels "Pleural line" and "B-lines".
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale curvilinear-sector ultrasound image on a black background. The superficial part shows horizontal layered echogenic bands, beneath which a curved bright line lies. A white text label "Pleural line" sits on the right with a downward-pointing white arrow beneath it that ends below that curved line, in the darker area to the right of the streaks. Below it, several vertical bright streaks extend from the pleural line toward the bottom of the sector; a white arrow pointing up and to the left with the text label "B-lines" marks them. The streaks are narrow, roughly parallel and fan slightly with the sector. The two arrows and their text labels are the only annotations; there are no panel letters, scale bars, depth markers, measurement calipers, burned-in patient text, dates or scanner text visible. Laterality, intercostal space and probe position are not printed.
